name: Marcos Cordero Tenreyro
introduction: I connect business, technology and user needs to build financial products.
about: My experience combines product strategy, trading platforms and operational knowledge of capital markets. I work across the product lifecycle, from defining the vision and roadmap to delivery and continuous improvement.

I translate business needs into clear requirements, prioritize the backlog and coordinate Development, Data, Compliance and Operations teams. I use metrics to guide decisions and AI tools to improve functional specifications and documentation.

experience.description: Product vision, strategy and development of FinTech solutions for capital markets.
highlights: Defined the roadmap, OKRs and backlog; managed the product lifecycle from discovery through delivery and continuous improvement.
Coordinated Technology, Data, Compliance and Operations teams to align priorities and requirements.
Automated processes and regulatory calculations, reducing processing time from hours to minutes.
Modeled processes with BPMN, documented APIs and incorporated AI into functional specifications and documentation.

experience.description: Functional analysis of the MAE API suite and the trading operations website.
highlights: Gathered and documented internal and external user needs.
Defined requirements with technical teams and contributed to the development of products and their interfaces.

experience.description: Technical support and operational continuity for capital markets platforms.
highlights: Resolved incidents with L1 Support, Development and Product teams; produced technical and functional documentation.
Automated operational controls and daily checks to support stability and data integrity.

experience.description: Led customer service and technical and operational support for market participants.
highlights: Supported trade registration and accounting, tax and compliance processes.
Liaised with CNV, AFIP and UIF and provided operational and functional support to clients.

experience.description: Settlement of local trades and coordination of international transactions.
highlights: Handled operations on BYMA, Matba-Rofex and MAV; coordinated with international brokers.
Managed clearing with DTC, Euroclear, Clearstream, Iberclear and Caja de Valores; performed accounting reconciliations.
Supported compliance with CNV and UIF regulations and anti-money laundering and counter-terrorist financing requirements.
